Put a staged upload's version in use (Requirement 13.3). A SNOMED CT or
CPT import needs ``licence_confirmed`` true - the confirmation is recorded
with the version (Requirement 13.8); the list's AI flag is then off by
default (Requirement 22.3). Refused on an HA standby.
